papers.title: Efficient Vision-Language-Action World Models for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: We present an efficient vision-language-action world model for long-horizon robotic manipulation. The model predicts action-conditioned latent dynamics and reduces policy inference latency while preserving task success across tabletop benchmarks.

papers.title: Quantized Robot Foundation Models on Edge Accelerators
papers.abstract: This work studies model quantization and efficient inference for a robot foundation model. A mixed-precision serving system improves latency, throughput, and memory use for multimodal policy execution on edge accelerators.

papers.title: Latent Action Models for Generalist Humanoid Control
papers.abstract: We introduce a latent action model for generalist humanoid robot control. The policy combines spatial reasoning, action chunking, and imitation learning to transfer manipulation skills across embodiments.

zotero.title: Vision Language Action Models and Robot World Models
zotero.abstract: We study action-conditioned world models, multimodal robot policies, and efficient inference for manipulation.

full_texts.arxiv:2608.12345:v1: Introduction. Long-horizon robotic manipulation requires efficient closed-loop vision-language-action inference. Method. We train an action-conditioned latent world model and use temporal action chunking. Experiments. We evaluate tabletop tasks and report lower latency while preserving task success. Limitations. The evaluation covers a limited set of robots.
